_comment: 50 evaluation queries. Each one carries a list of `expected_relevant_source_ids` — the parent_source_id values the retriever should put in the top-k. We deliberately mix easy CVE-recall queries, OSINT-topic queries that depend on PDFs in the corpus, and hard negatives where the corpus does NOT contain an answer (the system should refuse).
